entities.name: Ján Čarnogurský

entities.summary: Ján Čarnogurský is a Slovak former politician, who served as the Prime Minister of Slovakia (1991–1992), the former chairman of the Christian Democratic Movement (1990–2000), author and columnist. Today he is chairman of Slovak-Russian association with headquarters in Bratislava.
